We need to implement solve(case) for task NLP-LLM-01. The case payload contains "segments" (list of objects with name, importance, minimum, capacity) and "budget". The output must have allocations (list of integers, one per segment in order), by_name (object mapping segment names to their allocation), and total (sum of allocations). The algorithm: initialize each segment to its minimum. Then while sum(allocations) < budget, repeatedly allocate one token to the segment with maximum importance / (next position+1?) Actually the description: "importance divided by its next allocated position". So for a segment, after allocating k tokens (including min), the next token would be at position k+1 (0-indexed?). Let's interpret: importance divided by the next allocated position. If we have already allocated a_i tokens (including minimum), then the score for next token is importance / (a_i + 1). Or possibly a_i is the count already allocated (so next position index is a_i). The phrase "its next allocated position" suggests if we give the next token, it will be at position (current allocations + 1). So denominator = current_allocations + 1. So we allocate to segment with highest importance/(current+1). Tie break by original segment order (index). Continue until total allocated equals budget. If budget is less than sum of minima, raise ValueError. If budget > total capacity (sum of capacities), raise ValueError. Also need to ensure we don't exceed capacity per segment: we should only consider segments that have not reached capacity. So during allocation, only consider segments with current_alloc < capacity. If budget is exactly sum of minima, then allocations = minima. If budget is between sum of minima and total capacity, allocate additional tokens as described. If budget equals total capacity, allocate all segments to capacity. So algorithm: validate sum(minima) <= budget <= sum(capacities). Then start with allocations = [m for each segment]. Then remaining = budget - sum(minima). While remaining > 0, find eligible segment (current_alloc < capacity) with max importance/(current_alloc+1). Tie break by index. Increment that segment's allocation by 1, decrease remaining by 1. At the end, total = sum(allocations) = budget. Return dict with allocations (list of ints in segment order), by_name (dict mapping name to allocation), total.
